Sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] '''attacked''' the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-controlled [[Quermia system/Legends|Quermia system]] following a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Battle of the Makem system (Mandalorian Wars)|victory]] at the [[Makem system|Makem]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. The Mandalorians triumphed in the Quermia system before going on to win a [[Battle of the Kaelta system|battle]] in the [[Kaelta system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Quermia system was referenced in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
